actions: Audited current public SkillSmith capability-holdout, rejection-memory, capability-memory and proposer-context implementation paths.
Audited current public Regimes LongMemEval authoring, transform-class gate coverage, CONFIRM promotion/revert path and paper-reported repeated-CONFIRM behavior.
Checked current public Antahkarana v11 claim surface for inspectable SelfImproveGate/INV-41 implementation; implementation-level verification remained unavailable.
Added a fresh adaptivity-analysis theoretical source as a measurement direction without treating it as agent causal evidence.
Persisted a new role-local checkpoint and advanced the role-local LATEST pointer using repository CAS/readback discipline.
material_findings: SkillSmith capability_holdout is carved from the current failure cluster, exposes holdout task identity in the capability hypothesis, and can feed exact rejected holdout outcomes back through persistent anti-pattern memory; it is a local generalization check, not reusable-holdout-safe evidence.

Regimes gates all inspected behavioral transform classes on a disjoint CONFIRM split and does not directly feed CONFIRM outcomes into the inspected LLMAuthor path, yet repeated reuse of the same CONFIRM set still creates adaptive selection; the paper's seed-101 sequence empirically shows noise-level late promotions degrading the final state.
Low-bandwidth accept/reject decisions and the resulting persistent deployed-state lineage are themselves an adaptive feedback channel even without direct score leakage.
Antahkarana v11 SelfImproveGate/INV-41 remains a promising but not independently implementation-verified claim in the accessible public surface.
termination_cause: physical invocation checkpoint after material findings; open-ended frontier remains nonempty
exact_next_action: Find a public >10-proposal real self-improving agent with exogenous incumbent/candidate gating, repeated-selection-safe acceptance or explicit global error/query budget, complete proposal chronology, and a truly untouched final test. Re-audit post-paper Regimes changes for plateau/fresh-confirm/third-split/sequential control and continue Antahkarana v11 source verification.
